text:
Anya: Hey team! Today marks my 5-year Redwood anniversary 🎉 I was thinking a tiny celebration — sparkler-friendly (outdoors) + fika tomorrow at 3:30pm in the courtyard. Who's in? Thinking potluck-style snacks. Vote below for sweet vs savory and add what you'd bring.

Maya: Huge congrats Anya!! :tada: I'm in — I'll bring cardamom buns (my specialty).

Sam: Congrats!! I can bring a coffee urn and extra grounds ☕️ — count me in.

Priya: Oh wow congrats Anya!! I can do savory tarts. Also low-key petitioning for a mini raffle (one lucky person gets a coffee on me) 😉

Ravi: :clap: love this. I'll bring sparkling water and a small speaker for chill background music.

Jordan: @Anya congrats!! Will RSVP. Quick Q: courtyard last time Facilities asked to keep under 50 people — should we check capacity?

PeopleOps-Bot: PeopleOps-Bot: Calendar event created: "Anya 5yr Sparkler + Fika" — 2024-06-12 15:30-16:00 (📍 Courtyard). RSVP please. https://calendar.redwood/events/1762345678

Lina: Cardamom buns = legend. I'll bring napkins and a tiny vase for the sparklers :sparkler:

Anya: Thank you all!! ❤️ Love the menu so far. For a quick poll: react with :cupcake: for "sweet" or :pretzel: for "savory". If you're bringing something, reply with the item so we don't duplicate.

Maya: :cupcake: (sweet) — cardamom buns

Sam: :cupcake: sweet + coffee urn

Priya: :pretzel: savory tarts

Ravi: :pretzel: sparkling water + chips

Jordan: :cupcake: lemon bars

PeopleOps-Bot: PeopleOps-Bot: Facilities note — courtyard capacity 40. If headcount >40 we'll move to the 2nd-floor lounge. Ping facilities@redwood to request extra tables.

Anya: Got it — thanks for the heads up. If we need to move, I'll update the event. Big thanks to everyone helping set up (Sam, Lina, Maya). See you tomorrow! :heart:
